description: Change a draft or scheduled post: working title, main text, hashtags, format, or its channels and their own texts (sending channels replaces the whole set). Fields you omit stay as they are; images cannot be changed here. Refused for a published post — a post already live on a network cannot be changed from Obriym; create a new one instead. Refused while the post is being published. Repeating the same call changes nothing further. Echoes the workspace.

channels.description: Replaces the post's channels and their texts. Omit to keep them as they are.

channel.description: A social channel: telegram (the bound Telegram channel), instagram, facebook (the Facebook page), linkedin or threads. Use only channels list_content_channels reports as ready.

text.description: Text written for THIS network only. Omit it to publish the post's main text. It must fit the channel's maxTextLength from list_content_channels together with the hashtags (Threads allows 500 characters, Instagram 2200).

format.description: post = a regular feed post; story = an Instagram/Facebook story, which needs an image. Defaults to post.

hashtags.description: Replaces the hashtags, without the "#" sign. Omit to keep them; [] removes them.

id.description: The publication id returned by create_content_post or list_content_posts.

title.description: An internal working title shown in Obriym's Publications list, e.g. "Monday — new arrivals". Never published.

name: update_content_post
title: Update post
